description: Run the full repository sync with the bundled deterministic runner: fetch the bound unit's artifact, plan against the real on-disk state, apply atomically with rollback, run the repo's checks (SHIPPP_SYNC_CHECKS env), and write the receipt ONLY on full success. Writes are confined to the generated root of the repo's own binding; hand-modified generated files are structured conflicts and are never overwritten. If the plan or a refusal reports a compilerDelta, present it to the user and re-call with approvedCompilerDelta set to EXACTLY those lines ONLY after their explicit approval. After an approved re-bind, pass acceptReboundBaseline to adopt the previous binding's receipt as baseline.

acceptReboundBaseline.description: Explicit adoption of a previous binding's leftover receipt as hash baseline after a re-bind.

approvedCompilerDelta.description: The exact compilerDelta lines the user explicitly approved — a mismatch with the current delta refuses.

name: shippp_sync_apply
